reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, correctly linking Al-driven atomic-size mismatch to lattice distortion, phase stability, and property trade-offs, though it slightly oversimplifies the complex interplay of mixing enthalpy and entropy in this specific alloy system.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and comprehensive, with a well-defined falsification criterion, but the sheer number of property measurements (high-T, cryogenic, radiation, environmental) makes a single decisive experiment impractical.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful as it proposes a clear, tunable parameter (Al content) to control multiple critical properties, directly addressing the research question with a testable mechanistic framework.
